data.value: We reviewed your request to recover your ArquitecturaBase account and could not confirm that it belongs to you. You can submit a new request from the sign-in page.

data.value: Someone requested recovery of your ArquitecturaBase account. A person from the platform will review the request before changing anything. If this was you, you do not need to do anything. If it was not you, contact {{1}} for help.

data.value: The platform started deletion of your ArquitecturaBase account. It will be deleted on {{1}}. Your account is suspended, so you cannot cancel deletion. If you believe this is a mistake, contact {{2}} for help.
